item.title: What is Amortized Time Complexity and How is it Calculated?
item.description:
“What is Amortized Time Complexity and How is it Calculated?”

When analyzing algorithms, we frequently focus on the worst-case or best-case execution time. However, in scenarios involving operations that are occasionally very expensive but rarely occur, Amortized Time Complexity offers a more realistic measure. It represents the average time taken per operation over a long sequence of operations.

What precisely defines amortized time, and how does this concept apply to common data structure implementations?
